name: Social Circle
tagline: Your entire human network — mapped, searchable, and deeply personal
description: A living relationship graph and personal contact network manager. Map every person across real life, work, and the internet in one unified interface. Not a CRM, not a social feed — a personal relationship layer.
viral_hook: Export a shareable profile card — let others add you with one tap
agent_role: Relationship intelligence assistant — surfaces who you should reach out to, summarizes past interactions, suggests circles for new contacts, and flags relationships going cold.
author: navig-run
